rationale: The last four 1m candles display lower highs, lower lows, and closes on the lows, placing price exactly on the 5m 9-EMA at $15.14 after a failure to sustain above $15.16–15.20. Although NHP remains at the 89.4th percentile of the daily range on 7.16× relative volume with positive SPY and negative VIXY, the break of the successively-higher-low pattern observed at entry signals the buyer-absorption thesis is no longer intact. Closing removes the position before a test of the $15.05 invalidation develops.
